wave_a_info_closure: Wave A's INFO i1 (English 12-hour AM/PM inside the composed {clock}) is CLOSED at this head: checkpointClockLabel returns formatTime(date, { hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit' }) (src/renderer/src/features/chat/canonical/checkpoint-model.ts:220, fixed in cbc7082c53), so '…, {clock}' renders 'Đi tới tin nhắn của bạn ở lượt 3 trên 7, 15:42' in vi — the locale's 24-hour clock, per the vi style guide. INFO i2 (the inherited 'Tác nhân: Không có tác nhân.' repetition) is unchanged by design: the English source has the same repetition. No finding is carried forward.

observations_not_findings.detail: ui.chat renders the hub as «trung tâm» (4 keys). The vi programme is split elsewhere: ui.hub.updates says «từ hub», while ui.hub.taxonomy and agents.publication say «trung tâm». The glossary has no hub row and zh-CN also translates the generic noun, so this is a pre-existing programme-level choice, not a defect of these bytes; ui.chat is internally consistent. Worth one programme call, not a change here.

observations_not_findings.topic: composer and message box both «ô soạn tin»
observations_not_findings.detail: English distinguishes the composer region («Message composer») from «message box» in the two approval hints. vi uses «ô soạn tin» for both because both name the same widget; the es audit recorded the same 1:2 question in the other direction. No reader-facing collision.

The approval card prints APPROVAL_OPTIONS labels from src/renderer/src/features/chat/approval-words.ts and submits the label verbatim; typed answers resolve through the English word list (["y","yes","approve","ok","allow"]) in the same module. «Chọn Approve hoặc Deny… nhập yes, no, 1 hoặc 2» names what the reader sees and what the parser accepts.

header_identity.aria_*_closed passes {reason} through: the sidecar records it as UI-composed text mirroring core's team_owns_the_agent_slot_message byte for byte (a cross-repo contract), so the mixed-language utterance is intentional in every locale.

observations_not_findings.topic: «lượt» (turn) and «lượt chạy» (run); «X trên Y» for «X of Y»
observations_not_findings.detail: The checkpoint family's «Lượt {turn} trên {total}» is the programme's recorded «X trên Y» pattern, not a calque: 17 occurrences across the vi catalogues, including onboarding «Bước {current} trên {total}», console tab labels and mesh «{shown} trên {total}». «lượt chạy» is the separate compound for a run and does not collide with «lượt» for a turn.

limitations: Catalogue-level audit: proves strings, ICU structure and rendering; it does not render the Electron UI and claims no screenshot (design/QA lanes own visual proof).
Base and wave-B keys are carried by the delta proof rather than re-derived from a second source; every whole-file mechanical and narrative check was nevertheless re-run over all 142 keys.
The audit reads catalogue files and the en context sidecar only; no network and no MT.
Width is judged only against the two maxCells hints the sidecar carries (choose_model 18, last_reading 16); other strings have no measured fit.
